id.description: Canonical skill id, matching its folder name under skills/<family>/. Never runtime-specific (e.g. 'dev-seo', never 'claude-dev-seo').

category.description: Human-readable category matching the skill's family (e.g. 'pre-sales' for av-*, 'development' for dev-*).

compatibility.description: Map of runtime id -> declared compatibility. Only include a runtime here once its status has actually been checked; omit rather than guess.

compatibilityStatus.description: native: runtime consumes SKILL.md unmodified via a verified, documented mechanism. supported: works through a known but distinct install path, not fully verified. adapted: requires a script-generated transformation. unsupported: verified not to work. unknown: not yet verified.
